newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - DMCI Holdings rated hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DMCI Holdings rated hold.

text.p: Construction concern DMCI Holdings Inc was rated hold on Wednesday by Angping Securities due to its expected high earnings growth next year despite its expensive price.
Analyst Warren Chua said "although it seems to be fairly valued already, there is still room for an upside to the share price considering the 56 percent growth in earnings by next year."
DMCI is currently trading respectively at 21.3 times and 13.7 times forecast 1996 earnings per share (EPS) of 0.88 peso and 1997 EPS of 1.37 pesos, he said

The plan to issue one billion to as much as 2.4 billion pesos worth of convertible preferred shares is aimed at intensifying DMCI's focus on infrastucture and property development activities which should ensure long-term profit growth for the company, he said.
